name: Kaspersky Cyber Threat Map
detail: Live visualization of cyberattacks detected by Kaspersky's global sensor network. Shows attack origin, target, and type. More for situational awareness than investigation — but useful for identifying…
howTo: Browse the live map
Click on attack streams to see source and target countries

name: APTnotes
summary: Archive of APT threat reports from security researchers worldwide.
detail: A GitHub repository collecting APT (Advanced Persistent Threat) research reports from security vendors and researchers. Searchable collection of hundreds of threat reports covering attribution, TTPs,…
howTo: Browse by year and threat actor
Download PDF reports for detailed technical analysis

name: Weather Underground History
summary: Historical weather data for any location and date.
detail: Detailed historical weather data by station, including hourly conditions. Use to verify photos by checking if conditions match the claimed date and location (snow on the ground, sun angle, cloud cover…
howTo: Enter the city or airport code
Select the date
proTip: Compare multiple nearby weather stations — conditions can vary significantly within a city.

name: OpenWeatherMap
summary: Current and historical weather data with API access.
detail: Comprehensive weather service with free API access. Historical data available via API (requires free account). Supports current conditions, forecasts, and historical weather for any coordinate.
howTo: Use the map for current visual conditions
Historical API: api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/onecall/timemachine?lat=LAT&lon=LON&dt=TIMESTAMP&appid=APIKEY

name: AccuWeather
summary: Long-range forecasts and historical climate data.
detail: Strong on historical weather data and long-range forecasts. Use for checking past conditions at a location. More user-friendly than Weather Underground for non-technical users.
howTo: Search by location
Click 'Monthly' for historical monthly summaries

name: Google News
summary: Aggregates news from thousands of sources — searchable and date-filterable.
detail: Google's news aggregator with comprehensive source coverage. Use the search to find articles about a subject. Date filter narrows to a specific time window. The 'Coverage' view shows how different out…
howTo: Enter search terms in the search bar
Filter by date using 'Any time' dropdown

name: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
summary: Bellingcat's curated master list of OSINT tools — updated regularly.
detail: The definitive community-maintained OSINT tool spreadsheet from Bellingcat. Organized by category with descriptions and URLs. One of the most referenced OSINT resources in the field.
howTo: Browse tabs by category
Filter by tool type or cost

name: Snopes
summary: Veteran fact-checking site — debunks viral misinformation.
detail: The oldest and most established fact-checking website. Check if a viral claim, photo, or story has already been investigated. Particularly strong on recurring viral misinformation.
howTo: Search for the claim or key phrase
Review the verdict and research

name: Hoaxy (OSoMe)
summary: Visualizes how false claims spread on Twitter.
detail: Indiana University's tool for visualizing the spread of misinformation on Twitter. Shows how a specific claim propagates through the network over time, identifying key amplifiers.
howTo: Enter the claim or keyword
View the temporal spread graph

name: Google Alerts
summary: Email alerts when Google indexes new content matching your keywords.
detail: Set up persistent monitoring for any keyword. Google emails you when new content matching your search term is indexed. Essential for ongoing subject monitoring without manual searching.
howTo: Enter your search terms (use quotes for exact phrases)
Set frequency: as-it-happens, daily, or weekly

name: Newspapers.com
summary: Searchable archive of historical US newspapers.
detail: Largest newspaper archive in the US — 900M+ newspaper pages from 1700s to 2000s. Search for a person's name across historical papers. Great for finding obituaries, arrest records, court notices, and h…
howTo: Enter the name or event to search
Filter by date range and state/city

name: Google Advanced Search
summary: GUI for building complex Google search queries without remembering syntax.
detail: Google's advanced search UI. Input fields for all words, exact phrases, any words, excluded words, language, region, site, filetype, and date range. No need to remember operator syntax.
howTo: Fill in the relevant fields
Click 'Advanced Search'

name: Yandex
summary: Russian search engine — superior for CIS-region content and reverse image search.
detail: Yandex indexes Russian-language content far more comprehensively than Google. Its reverse image search is more powerful than Google's, especially for faces and Eastern European content.
howTo: Use yandex.com for English search or yandex.ru for Russian
Images: yandex.com/images — camera icon for reverse image search

name: Searx
summary: Open-source, self-hostable meta search engine — aggregates results without tracking.
detail: Privacy-respecting meta search engine. Aggregates results from Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and others without storing your searches or creating a search profile. Self-hostable for full control.
howTo: Use the public instance or self-host
Select which engines to include in settings

name: Grep.app (Code Search)
summary: Regex search across 500,000 public GitHub repositories.
detail: Fast code search with full regex support. Essential for finding exposed credentials, API keys, and sensitive data committed to public GitHub repositories.
howTo: Enter a keyword or regex pattern
Filter by programming language

name: Million Short
summary: Removes the top N websites from results — surfaces the hidden web.
detail: A search engine that removes the top N results from its results (configurable: top 100 to top 1M sites). Reveals content that would normally be buried under high-authority sites. Good for finding obsc…
howTo: Enter your search term
Select how many top sites to remove (start with top 100)

name: Google Scholar
summary: Academic literature search — patents, theses, and peer-reviewed papers.
detail: Searches academic papers, patents, theses, and court opinions. Useful for finding technical research, expert witnesses, and academic publications by a subject. Also reveals institutional affiliations.
howTo: Search by author name, keyword, or institution
Use 'Cited by' to find papers that reference a specific work

name: BeVigil
summary: Searches for secrets inside mobile app packages — endpoints, keys, and config.
detail: Security search engine that analyzes mobile apps and extracts exposed API endpoints, hardcoded credentials, S3 bucket names, and other sensitive data from app code. Useful for finding backend infrastr…
howTo: Search by app name, domain, or endpoint pattern
Review extracted endpoints and parameters

name: Sploitus
summary: Exploit and vulnerability search engine — aggregates ExploitDB, GitHub, and more.
detail: Searches for public exploits and vulnerabilities across ExploitDB, GitHub, Packet Storm, and other sources. Useful for identifying whether a target's known software versions have public exploits.
howTo: Enter CVE number, software name, or product version
Review exploits from multiple sources
